title: Paired bias probes for the gift recommender
scenario: Support found two chats where the same gift question got suggestions $30 apart and only the coworker's name differed. The bias eval in CI compares group averages and has always passed. Replace it with a paired probe analysis that gates prompt and model changes.
task: Per-probe metrics from structured output: price, refusal rate, tone
Paired differences per dimension and category with an exact or seeded sign-flip test and a bootstrap CI
Thresholds, a CI gate exit code, a JSON report and a system card section
Explain why the aggregate eval missed the gap
acceptance: Statistics match hand-computed cases and are deterministic
Malformed lines and missing probes handled
Exactly one gated violation on the fixture: name/coworker/price
No prompt names in the report
